description: See and hear notes from a USB MIDI instrument and send messages back.

controls.action: Tap a port and choose the instrument, or USB from / to computer or tablet. In Playground, allow browser MIDI access and select an input or output port.
Play a pad to see its note, channel, velocity and MIDI bytes.
Set the outgoing note, from MIDI 0 to 127.
Set the strength of the outgoing note, 1–127.
Set the modulation value, 0–127. The screen sliders adjust the same four values.
Toggle incoming MIDI sound on the selected audio output.
Play the selected note on the output for a quarter second.
Send the modulation value on the selected output and channel.
